SignIn.title: Sign in
SignIn.deleted: Your account will be deleted. You've been signed out, and we've emailed you the date.
SignIn.googleFailed: Google sign-in didn't work for this account. Ask your school admin to add you.
SignIn.confirmEmail: Confirm your email first — we've sent you a new link.
SignIn.tooMany: Too many attempts. Wait a minute and try again.
SignIn.wrong: That email and password don't match. Check them and try again.

Account.title: Account
Account.name: Name
Account.changeDetails: Ask a school admin to change your name or email.
Account.digestHelp: One email in the early evening, only on days with something new. Class reminders are emailed separately.
Account.recordingsText: See the recording notice, or agree to it or withdraw.
Account.deleteSignedOut: You're signed out everywhere at once and can't sign in again.
Account.deleteAfter: After {days} days your account and its data are deleted for good: your progress, {role, select, STUDENT {submissions, quiz answers, grades,} other {links to your children,}} notifications and agreements.
Account.deleteCancel: Until then, a school admin can cancel it if you change your mind.
Account.deleteRecordings: You may still appear in class recordings. Ask your school if you want one removed.
Account.deleteStaff: Teachers and admins own courses and classes, so a school admin deletes these accounts after handing them over.
